_comment: Coding tools SlopNet can check for and install on your server. 'check' is the command name looked for on the server; 'install' is run on the SERVER, in the console, so you can see exactly what happens. An empty 'install' means nobody has verified that tool's install command yet — SlopNet says so rather than guessing, because a wrong install command runs as you, on your machine. Add one and it appears in Settings; no rebuild needed beyond copying this file into the app.
